name: Saferpay Payment Gateway
description: Saferpay (Worldline/SIX) card payment gateway for the Arch suite.
project_description: Arch payment gateway submodule integrating the Saferpay (Worldline/SIX) hosted Payment Page: a configurable `saferpay` PaymentMethod plugin, a SaferpayHandler service that calls the Saferpay JSON API (PaymentPage Initialize/Assert, Transaction Capture) over HTTPS with basic auth, and controller routes for redirect/success/error/cancel. Supports a test/live toggle and PSD2 SCA forcing.
